title: Free-only capacity plan: offload trainer compute to Kaggle (2/30 GPU h/wk used), rebalance A1 memory in the free pool (gateway 6->3 GB, trainer 6->9 GB) in a market-closed window, lake via squash then free HF org; no paid hosting
note:
OPERATOR 2026-11-05 ~13:45Z, verbatim: "Regarding the Oracle stuff, I don't pay anything right now for that. For sure. Second of all, I don't really fully understand in that case if we actually need to ramp up something that we're paying for. Like, there would be advantages to having everything more concentrated or whatever, but if that's not the case, then we just need to find other free". So the price-list allowance of 3000 OCPU-h / 18000 GB-h applies (billed $0, operator-confirmed). Paid options (an extra $6.50 OCPU, HF PRO, Hetzner) are DROPPED. Concentration buys nothing: all 3 hosts run near 100% CPU and the gateway must stay isolated (HOSTING-COST-PLAN, PR #23327). WORK, free only:
(a) Move trainer-heavy training and research onto Kaggle GPU/CPU kernels (about 2 of 30 GPU h/wk used) and onto GitHub runners. Target: trainer CPU p95 under 80%.
(b) Rebalance A1 memory within the free 24 GB: gateway 6->3 GB (mem p95 about 30% of 6 GB), trainer 6->9 GB. A gateway resize restarts IB Gateway, so propose the exact window with MES/MGC/MHG closed and bring it to the operator before acting (Tier 2).
(c) Lake: HF-LAKE-SQUASH, then a free HF org if still near the cap.
